text: In 2023 Pon sold a 49% stake in Bike Mobility Services (BMS) — the Pon.Bike bike-leasing company whose brands are BusinessBike, Lease a Bike and B2Bike — to Volkswagen Financial Services, a business division of Volkswagen AG.
short: Volkswagen Financial Services holds 49% of Lease a Bike's parent Bike Mobility Services.

source.name: Volkswagen Financial Services: Bike leasing in Europe and the USA — Volkswagen Financial Services and Pon Holdings form strategic alliance
source.quote: VW FS will acquire a 49 percent stake in the Pon bike leasing subsidiary Bike Mobility Services (BMS)
source.note: The same page states: 'The BMS brands are BusinessBike, Lease a Bike and B2Bike. ... BMS is part of Pon.Bike' and 'Volkswagen Financial Services are a business division of the Volkswagen AG group of companies'.

additionalSources.name: De Brauw Blackstone Westbroek: Pon and Volkswagen Financial Services enter into strategic alliance in Bike Mobility Services
additionalSources.quote: Pon sold a 49% stake in the Bike Mobility Services group ("BMS") to Volkswagen Financial Services ("VWFS")
additionalSources.note: Pon's counsel confirming the completed sale; see also EU merger case M.11321 (joint control of Bike Mobility Services B.V. by Volkswagen Financial Services AG and Pon Bicycle Holding B.V.).
